## Goal
- Build and deploy IVX IA as a **fully owner-controlled AI engineering platform** that can operate, code, test, commit, deploy, monitor, and recover WITHOUT Rork — execute end-to-end, not return only a plan; remove all Rork dependencies from the normal development path; verify and sync all credentials live; **rebuild IVX Owner AI as a REAL senior developer that never reports false completion**

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_FACTORY_MODE, CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH, CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR, CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD, CONFIRM_IVX_LANDING_UPLOAD, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION
- No fake data, no placeholder progress — honest about what can/cannot be done from inside Rork sandbox
- Owner demands honest senior-developer audit — NOT narrative claims; wants real end-to-end proof
- Owner demands Senior Developer answer format: structured TASK ID / STATUS / FILES CHANGED / COMMANDS / TESTS / DEPLOYED proof — NOT product-support summaries
- **CRITICAL**: DEPLOYED ≠ VERIFIED; a CODE_FIX/UI_FIX/FEATURE task with no code change is NOT complete
- **CRITICAL SECURITY**: never display/log/store passwords in screenshots, logs, analytics, alerts, proof reports; redact as ********; never hardcode passwords; never bypass Supabase auth
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}` — use Python `gzip.compress()` + `base64.b64encode()`; repo-root relative paths
- **Rork sandbox `git push` goes to Rork git router, NOT canonical GitHub** — must use owner-gated `github_commit_file` API to push to canonical repo
- Render deploy API: same endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- Render restart API: `{action: "render_restart_service", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE"}`
- Render update source: `{action: "render_update_source", input: {branch: "main", commitSha}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE"}`
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at.json` (JSON with `accessToken` field); re-mint via POST `https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}`; token expires ~1h; **can refresh via Supabase `POST /auth/v1/token?grant_type=refresh_token` with anon key + refreshToken**
- APK/landing presign upload API: `POST /api/ivx/apk/presign-upload` with top-level `{key, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_LANDING_UPLOAD"}` (NOT nested under action/input) — returns `uploadUrl` (S3 presigned PUT) + `publicUrl`; then PUT the file to `uploadUrl`
- Landing upload whitelist pattern: `^(index\.html|reset-password\.html|robots\.txt|sitemap\.xml|ivx-[a-z0-9-]{1,60}\.(js|json)|landing-support-chat\.(js|css))$`
- Correct API host is `https://api.ivxholding.com` (NOT `https://ivxholding.com` which returns HTML)
- Health endpoint: `GET https://api.ivxholding.com/health` returns `{commit, status}` — use to verify deploy propagation
- `bun test backend/` = 1709 pass / 0 fail (6230 expects)
- Bash commands must complete under 60s or timeout; Render propagation ~2-5 min; use nohup background + poll for long ops
- Clean sandbox has NO `node_modules` — must run `bun install` before tests or tsc
- `watchman` disabled (renamed to `/usr/local/bin/watchman.disabled`) to prevent Metro/Gradle build hangs
- **MFA must be optional, OFF by default** — owner was very angry it was enforced; demanded immediate removal and proof
- Owner authorized backend bypass for AAL2 — wants it fixed now without touching Supabase dashboard
- **Owner demands Amazon/Instagram-level sign-in UX** — said "I need to have sign in like Amazon level Instagram level you provide very poor level"
- Owner frustrated when assistant stops mid-build — demands end-to-end completion, not partial status reports

## Progress
### Done
- **CERTIFICATION FIX — DEFECT 1 & 2 — FIXED, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED, LIVE-VERIFIED**
  - Commits: `83cd9efdf9ec` + `ebbdc7c52d42` + `11b323a86aba` + `ada4bddd4846` + `2efbffcc15e3`
  - 11 routing + QA regression tests all passing

- **ENTERPRISE AUTH RECOVERY — PHASES 1-17 — CODE-LEVEL COMPLETE (~70% VERIFIED)**
  - Phase 1-4: Security freeze, Supabase project match, owner audit, password invalidation + session revocation
  - Phase 5: Password policy 12-char min — commit `9863d7b01187`
  - Phase 6: Login trace IDs — commit `35c42edc61dd`
  - Phase 7-11: Auth conflicts audit, MFA verified OFF by default
  - Phase 15: 32/32 enterprise auth tests pass (94 expects)
  - Phase 17: Production proof report delivered
  - APK v1.4.27(59) + v1.4.28(60) — BUILT, UPLOADED, LIVE-VERIFIED (prior sessions)

- **FORGOT PASSWORD 429 RATE-LIMIT HANDLING — FIXED, DEPLOYED**
  - `expo/app/forgot-password.tsx` detects 429 `over_email_send_rate_limit` and shows user-friendly wait message
  - Commit: `ecad2525ce39`

- **BACKEND SES PASSWORD RESET FALLBACK — BUILT, DEPLOYED, LIVE**
  - Action `send_owner_password_reset_email_via_ses` generates Supabase recovery link via admin REST API and sends via Amazon SES

- **AWS SES IDENTITY VERIFICATION ACTIONS — BUILT, DEPLOYED, LIVE**
  - `verify_ses_email_identity` and `list_ses_identities` actions
  - Verified identities: `ivxholding.com`, `osconstructors@gmail.com`, `noreply@ivxholding.com`
  - `iperez4242@gmail.com` verification email sent but NOT confirmed by owner

- **`generate_owner_password_reset_link` ACTION — BUILT, DEPLOYED, LIVE**
  - Returns Supabase reset link directly in API response — bypasses email delivery
  - Includes `replaceRedirectUrlInSupabaseActionLink()` to rewrite `redirect_to` param

- **SUPABASE `uri_allow_list` FIX — DEPLOYED, LIVE-VERIFIED**
  - Backend REPLACES `uri_allow_list` with single working URL — Supabase corrupted space-separated multi-URL values
  - Commit `ba77c614d8d2` — deployed and live
  - `uri_allow_list` now contains only `https://ivxholding.com/reset-password.html`

- **RESET-PASSWORD LANDING PAGE — BUILT, UPLOADED, LIVE-VERIFIED**
  - `expo/ivxholding-landing/reset-password.html` — real web-based reset page with Supabase client-side auth
  - Live at `https://ivxholding.com/reset-password.html` — HTTP 200, 14825 bytes

- **OWNER PASSWORD RESET VIA ADMIN API — COMPLETED, LIVE-VERIFIED**
  - `supabase_reset_owner_password` action succeeded — passwordReset: True, sessionsRevoked: True, emailConfirmed: True
  - Owner can sign in — verified live via `POST https://kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb.supabase.co/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password` → HTTP 200

- **MFA FACTOR UNENROLL — COMPLETED**
  - 0 MFA factors on account; AAL2 block is from global Supabase project setting `mfa_allow_low_aal: false`

- **MFA AAL2 ENFORCEMENT DISABLE — DEPLOYED, RUN LIVE, CONFIRMED BLOCKED VIA API**
  - `disable_supabase_mfa_aal2_enforcement` action returned HTTP 200 but `mfa_allow_low_aal` stayed `false`
  - Supabase Management API only updated `uri_allow_list` in the PATCH; `mfa_allow_low_aal` NOT writable via Management API
  - `supabase_execute_sql` also BLOCKED — requires DB URL env vars not in Render env

- **BACKEND BYPASS ENDPOINT FOR PASSWORD UPDATES — BUILT, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED, LIVE-VERIFIED**
  - `backend/api/ivx-owner-update-password.ts` — owner-gated endpoint, verifies current password, updates via admin API bypassing AAL2
  - Wired into `backend/hono.ts` as `POST /api/ivx/owner-update-password` + OPTIONS, rate limited 5/0.3
  - Commits: `9ba73d8e968bdd612ccd62af9cae6810b76839b3` (endpoint) + `ad57c1337b36d23b463f3c0a9c5dfb2cde6e1ae6` (hono router)
  - Deployed to Render, verified LIVE via `/health` → commit `9ba73d8e`, status healthy

- **APP-SIDE BYPASS WIRING — BUILT, COMMITTED**
  - `expo/lib/owner-password-update-bypass.ts` — `updateOwnerPasswordViaBackend()` helper, falls back to `supabase.auth.updateUser` if backend unreachable
  - `expo/app/security-settings.tsx` — changePasswordMutation uses bypass as primary path
  - `expo/app/reset-password.tsx` — uses client-side `supabase.auth.updateUser()` as primary, falls back to bypass only if AAL2 error
  - Commits: `427cb13b71659bca8e04dfaa09be8f97bd142394` (helper) + `49fa9bfe` (security-settings) + `52f497f4` (reset-password)

- **ENTERPRISE LOGIN UX REBUILD — BUILT, COMMITTED, NOT YET SHIPPED IN APK**
  - `expo/app/login.tsx` (3199 lines) — all diagnostic machinery (telemetry panel, repair-debug JSON, server-repair button, issue matrix, owner-access notice, trusted-restore card, truth card) collapsed behind single "Troubleshoot access" disclosure
  - Clean default view: email + password + Sign In + Forgot? + Remember Me + one-line inline error
  - Commit: `fb86bc8d`
  - Version bumped → v1.4.29(60) in `app.config.ts` commit `7ccbe7b3`; build.gradle versionCode 61 commit `c37dcdfa`

- **MIPMAPS REGENERATED THIS SESSION**
  - Clean sandbox wiped `android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-*/` and `drawable/splashscreen_logo.png`
  - Regenerated via ffmpeg from `expo/assets/images/icon.png`, `adaptive-icon.png`, `splash-icon.png`
  - All densities: mdpi(48), hdpi(72), xhdpi(96), xxhdpi(144), xxxhdpi(192) + splashscreen_logo.png(288)

### In Progress
- **APK v1.4.29 BUILD — FAILING**
  - Gradle `assembleRelease` fails at `settings.gradle` line 3: `node --print "require.resolve('react-native/package.json')"` → `Error: Cannot find module 'react-native/package.json'`
  - `node_modules` directory exists but `react-native` package NOT resolvable — likely needs `bun install` or `npm install` in `expo/` dir
  - Owner token re-minted successfully (AT_LEN 1620) at `/tmp/owner_at.json`

### Blocked
- **Gradle build fails**: `settings.gradle` line 3 — `Cannot find module 'react-native/package.json'` — `node_modules` present but `react-native` not installed/resolvable; need to run `bun install` or `npm install` in `expo/` directory
- **Version mismatch**: `android/app/build.gradle` has versionCode 61, `app.config.ts` has versionCode 60 — need to sync
- **Supabase `mfa_allow_low_aal`**: NOT writable via Management API — only dashboard toggle can change it

## Key Decisions
- Backend bypass endpoint chosen over Supabase Management API for AAL2 password updates — Management API cannot write `mfa_allow_low_aal`, so password changes route through service-role admin API instead
- Login UX uses disclosure pattern (not removal) — full diagnostic panel still available behind "Troubleshoot access" toggle, just collapsed by default for clean Amazon/Instagram-level view
- Mipmaps regenerated via ffmpeg from app assets each clean-sandbox session — gradle silently exits without producing APK if launcher icons are missing

## Next Steps
1. Fix `react-native` module resolution — run `bun install` or `npm install` in `expo/` directory, verify `node --print "require.resolve('react-native/package.json')"` succeeds
2. Sync versionCode: align `app.config.ts` (60) with `build.gradle` (61) or vice versa
3. Run `./gradlew assembleRelease` in foreground with captured logs, verify BUILD SUCCESSFUL
4. Upload APK via `presign-upload` API (CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD), verify live at `https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.29.apk`
5. Verify end-to-end: login screen clean UX + password change bypass works on device

## Critical Context
- **APK was NEVER built this session** — gradle kept silently exiting; assistant repeatedly polled a dead daemon instead of reading the actual error log; root cause is `react-native` not in `node_modules`
- **Login UX code is committed but NOT shipped** — owner cannot see the Amazon/Instagram-level login until APK is built + uploaded + installed
